goal: Compare AX Engine Qwen 3.8 Flash Next against the omlx, MTPLX and ds4 peers on the ADR-037 target host. Declares identity and preconditions only; it records no numbers, because no Flash Next weights and no Ultra-class host exist on the authoring machine.
note: Peer numbers produced by this contract are unverified until run on the declared target host with the declared pack revision. Nothing here closes MTP-S, MTP-P, MTP-D, default admission or release.

target_host.description: Mac Studio, Ultra-class Apple Silicon (M2 Ultra or newer), 192 GiB or more

pack.format: MXFP4/group32 with per-tensor affine overrides and a BF16 MTP sidecar

fixed_conditions.stream_experts_rationale: ADR-034/ADR-037: Flash Next is stream-required on the 192 GiB Ultra-class host, so Auto may page it. Forcing off would fail closed on a required pack and would not measure the product path.
fixed_conditions.disable_prefix_cache_confound: cold and warm prompts must be reported as separate cells; a repeated prompt is a prefix-cache hit

peers.role: mlx-vlm qwen4_exp support behind a loader/patch layer
own qwen4_exp graph plus custom Metal kernels
qwen4exp GGUF MTP with a per-cycle draft retry the AX cursor policy does not have

reported_numbers_policy: unverified unless produced on the declared host and pack revision; never publish a peer speedup from this contract alone
